audience: on-call engineers and SRE teams who handle incidents and on-call shifts in Spike.sh

useCases.title: See which incidents are open and unacknowledged
useCases.text: The AI lists the triggered incidents of a team, with title, priority and severity, so you see the queue that needs action first.

useCases.title: Review an incident and its activity log
useCases.text: The AI opens one incident by its counter id with comments and repeated incidents, and reads the activity log to show who acknowledged, resolved or commented and when.

useCases.title: Find who is on call next
useCases.text: The AI lists a team's on-call schedules and returns the next shift for one, with the user and its start and end time.

useCases.title: Check escalation policies and services
useCases.text: The AI lists a team's escalation policies and services, and opens one to show its alert rules or its open incidents.

useCases.title: Acknowledge or resolve incidents and set priority
useCases.text: The AI acknowledges or resolves one or more incidents, or sets their priority from p1 to p5. This changes live incident state.
